# Communicare

> A small, slow-built tool for farm shares and the neighbors they feed.
> Communicare gives small farms a free homepage, a weekly SMS "swap loop"
> for members, and a public directory neighbors are searching. Nine dollars
> a month, no contracts, no trial (card required at signup). Card
> processing on the farm's behalf uses Stripe Connect at 1%. Part of the
> CROS family of tools (https://thecros.app).

## What it is

- A directory of real US farm shares (vegetable CSA, raw-milk herd share,
  pastured meat, mixed farm) searchable by ZIP with a live map.
- A homepage drafter that writes a farm's public site from six honest
  answers in the farmer's own voice.
- The Tuesday text loop: one SMS per member per week. Members reply YES,
  SKIP, PAUSE, or swap an item. TCPA / 10DLC compliant.
- A member roster, weekly order log, printable share cards, and a
  seasonal-pause + full JSON data export on request.
- Stripe billing at $9/mo (platform) plus optional 1% Managed Payments
  for farms who want the tool to take money for them.

## Who it's for

- Small direct-to-consumer farms who currently run their share on a
  spreadsheet, a binder, or one of the enterprise SaaS platforms that
  churn them out at $99+/mo.
- CSA members, herd-share holders, and meat-share subscribers looking
  for the farm they belong to.

## Key public pages

- / — Homepage, the pitch
- /find — Directory search (ZIP → farms within radius)
- /manifesto — Why we built it
- /journal — Notes from the workshop
- /roadmap — What's shipped, what's next
- /join — Bring a farm on
- /homepage — The homepage drafter (free to try)
- /demo — Working dashboard demo
- /privacy — Privacy policy
- /terms — Terms of service
- /refunds — Refund policy
- /support — Contact a human

## Not indexed

Dashboards behind auth (/farmer/*, /share/*, /admin/*) and the OAuth
callback (/auth/callback) are excluded from crawlers.
